scope: proxide_fixer only: NEW FILE sanitizers/hydrogens.rs implementing HydrogenSanitizer with IC-based H placement from FF residue templates
approach: 1. NEW FILE: crates/proxide_fixer/src/sanitizers/hydrogens.rs with HydrogenSanitizer struct, HydrogenError enum, HydrogenReport struct

2. Algorithm per residue: (1) ff.get_residue(name) -> template; (2) diff template H atoms vs present atoms; (3) for each missing H: find parent heavy atom; (4) classify geometry (sp3/sp2/aromatic); (5) place via Nerf::place_atom with CHARMM ideals; (6) append H atom with unique serial
3. Add pub mod hydrogens; to sanitizers/mod.rs
4. TEST: Create fixture no_hydrogens.pdb (heavy-atoms-only tripeptide or stripped clean_small.pdb); assert backbone HN/HA placed, ALA CB gets 3 H, bonds/angles match CHARMM ideals
5. VERIFY: cargo test -p proxide_fixer --features ... green; cargo clippy -p proxide_fixer --all-targets --features ... -- -D warnings clean; use clamp() not .max().min()
key_dependencies: ResidueTemplate.atoms: Vec<ResidueAtom> with .name: String; H atoms have element H
ResidueTemplate.bonds: Vec<(atom_name1, atom_name2)>; use to find parent of missing H
Nerf::place_atom(&[[f32;3];3], bond_len, angle_deg, torsion_deg) from proxide-geometry::nerf
CharmmIdeals::map_template_to_charmm_name to map residue codes to CHARMM names

geometry_rules.sp3_tetrahedral: ~109.5°, e.g. CB methyl (3 H) or backbone HA
geometry_rules.sp2_trigonal: ~120°, e.g. amide HN on N (sp2 hybridized in peptide bond context)
geometry_rules.aromatic: in-plane ~120°, e.g. aromatic CH in HIS/PHE/TRP rings

title: Implement Parallel `tmalign_pair`
overview: Introduce a parallel version of `tmalign_pair` using `orx_parallel` to evaluate candidate combinations concurrently, while maintaining the existing serial logic for individual candidate refinement.
success_criteria: `tmalign_pair` and `tmalign_pair_serial` produce identical results on Phase-2 test fixtures
Execution time for `tmalign_pair` is reduced on multi-core systems compared to `tmalign_pair_serial`

steps.description: Implement `tmalign_pair` in `pipeline.rs` using `orx_parallel` to iterate over (seed, gap_open) combinations.
Create a test fixture to compare results of `tmalign_pair` and `tmalign_pair_serial`.

risks.risk: Floating point non-determinism due to reduction order
risks.rollback_path: Revert to `tmalign_pair_serial` if results diverge beyond epsilon.

summary: Round-3 (final) revision of the silent-substitution observability spec. Five scoped items applied; two deliberate retreats recorded; six known limitations stated explicitly rather than papered.
resolutions: Item 1 -> new D15.1 + OBS-005: Detector ABC returns unfiltered findings, harness alone applies the ledger so suppression has no code path; REGISTRY <-> ledger <-> section 4.1 three-way assertion; expiry typed as expiry_kind/expiry_value (blocking_id|date|never); staleness circularity resolved by splitting --strict (no detectors) from --with-scan (IS the OBS-002 run)

Item 2 -> new D18 + OBS-006: every detector ships calibration/evasion/<detector>/ authored adversarially, seeded with the 11 known defeats. Two needed structural fixes: OBS-303d ratchets `claimed` against shrinking (deleting Se from masses.rs turned both P0 coverage gates green), and OBS-111 `source` becomes diff-reviewable structured evidence under constants/sources/

Item 3 -> --derive-ground-truth DROPPED as unimplementable (fix commit carries unrelated Br/I edits so recall 1.0 unreachable on the only seeded case; derivation cannot find sites the fix missed). Replaced by reviewed append-only checked-in ground truth + evasion corpus

Item 4 -> 54eefc2 vs 992377d disambiguated via tags calibration/element-inference-fixed-initial vs -fixed; all five raw-SHA leaks replaced; OBS-111/Z2a use -fixed-initial's parent as snapshot baseline
Item 5a -> D16 conditionality moved into OBS-112, OBS-113(b), B7 and D16 itself as a boxed OWNER DECISION PENDING with dependents enumerated

Item 5b -> corrected my own round-2 claim: lenient-by-default is 4 requirement edits + a new design decision + makes f32::NAN the default for unknown elements reaching MD integration, NOT one line. DiagPolicy::default() specified as strict() with max_findings = 1024
reference_impl_bugs_inherited: e78484e fixed two real holes in the artefact D15 tells implementers to copy: comment-disableable whole-file exclusion (silence read as 'fixed', retiring the exemption), and prefix-blanket exemptions. Both now normative in D15 as (a) counted-not-blanket via expected_findings and (b) a detector must not be disableable by content it does not control, generalised to 'a detector whose silence is indistinguishable from its success is not a detector'
